title: AudioMetadataRecord
description: Schema for one per-file JSON record produced by audio_metadata_extractor.py

audio_id.description: First 16 hex characters of the file's full SHA-256 digest. Used as the unique identifier and JSON filename.

original_filename.description: Original filename as found in the input folder (not modified).

sha256.description: Full SHA-256 hash of the raw file bytes. Identical files (even renamed) share the same hash.

format.description: Real container format detected from the file's bitstream via ffprobe (e.g. 'wav', 'mp3'), not just the file extension.

codec.description: Audio codec used inside the container (e.g. 'pcm_s16le', 'mp3').

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the audio stream in seconds.

channels.description: Number of audio channels (1 = mono, 2 = stereo, ...).

bit_depth.description: Bits per sample for PCM-style formats. Null for codecs where bit depth is not meaningful (e.g. MP3).

bitrate.description: Bitrate in bits per second, from the stream (or container if the stream value is unavailable).

file_size_bytes.description: Size of the original file on disk, in bytes.

peak_level.description: Maximum absolute sample amplitude, normalized to [0, 1] (1.0 = full scale).

rms_level.description: Root-mean-square amplitude of the decoded signal, normalized to [0, 1].

clipping_ratio.description: Fraction of samples at or above the clipping threshold (>= 0.999 of full scale).

silence_ratio.description: Approximate fraction of samples below the silence amplitude threshold (<= 0.01 of full scale).

decode_status.description: 'ok' if the file was successfully probed and decoded; 'error' if it is corrupted or unreadable.

error_message.description: Human-readable error description when decode_status is 'error'; null otherwise.

duplicate_of.description: original_filename of the first file that had the same SHA-256 hash, if this file is a byte-for-byte duplicate; null otherwise. (Note: audio_id itself cannot be used for this, since identical content always produces the identical audio_id.)

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to.

processed_at.description: UTC timestamp (ISO 8601) of when this record was generated.
